ORIGIN.quote: There are 3,103 revision labels, including names such as `OpenAIResearcher`, `ChatGPTJul19Agent`, and task-specific agents; 1,332 labels save only once.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader is shown OpenAI/ChatGPT-bearing aliases (plus many `...OAI...` agent names quoted throughout) but only ever as evidence of automation and volume; the report never once names OpenAI or any lab as a possible source, and its attribution discussion stops at "the logs do not establish who launched the agents" and "whether all aliases came from one test harness." This sits at 0.2 rather than 0.4 because OpenAI is never raised as a possibility to be entertained or set aside, and above 0.0 because the report itself, in its own prose, surfaces the OpenAI-bearing usernames the reader could connect unaided.
